source_evidence: Local FAAC .cache/abx-transients/tuning-evidence/full48k128/per-clip-metrics.json; inputs rehashed from faac-benchmark data/external/audio. Raw AAC files and private tuning scripts are not included.
metrics: Paired baseline/candidate rows; MOS, actual bitrate, stereo coherence error, attack-centroid absolute mean, and positive-clamped reference-locked pre-echo means with event coverage.
limits: This snapshot compares only FAAC baseline and the frozen candidate; it has no per-clip Apple/FDK rows. Use the rerunnable harness for a four-encoder comparison.
The snapshot is descriptive and does not reproduce the original ABX reports.
Pre-echo N/A means no eligible/scored reference events; 41 of 77 clips were N/A.
MOS BD-rate costs across four target curves were +4.878% to +18.078%; this snapshot is not an overall quality win.
